questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 2(x − 3)² + 1. What is the y-intercept of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane?
questions.explanation: The y-intercept occurs at x = 0: f(0) = 2(0 − 3)² + 1 = 2(9) + 1 = 19, so the y-intercept is (0, 19). The point (3, 1) is the vertex, not the y-intercept.

distractor_explanations.A: 1 is the y-coordinate of the vertex.
distractor_explanations.B: 7 computes 2(3) + 1, forgetting to square.
distractor_explanations.C: 10 computes (0 − 3)² + 1 without the factor 2.
